Calculate your new basic pay and net salary increase after 1st July annual increment — 7th Pay Commission
Based on the 7th CPC pay matrix and the current Dearness Allowance of 60% (effective 1 January 2026). HRA uses 30% / 20% / 10% for X / Y / Z cities, the rates that apply once DA is above 50%.
Rates last checked: 18 Oct 2026 . Results are estimates for planning — your pay slip, DDO/pension office or the official notification is final.
